verificationCorrections: Search desktop pagination adjusts 50 SSR rows to 51 after hydration; fixed assertion and reran all 12 browser scenarios.
Initial avatar fixtures and analytics script substitution produced test-only resource errors; intercepted avatars and allowed the intact analytics script while blocking reporting.
Blocked service-worker registration caused a test-only console error; main tests remove the unsupported API, and a separate real service-worker context verified registration, reload and navigation.
Service-worker version is build timestamp mvjtirsy, not package version; compared remote/local SHA-256 and actual GET_VERSION.
Cloudflare Speed Brain prefetch of /terms returned expected 503 with sec-purpose=prefetch; actual page navigation succeeded; no Worker 5xx.
limitations: Anonymous public read-only samples only; no production login/logout or authenticated writes.
Avatar proxy and external images substituted to avoid GitHub requests; image source availability not validated.
No production billing CPU, cross-region concurrency or CrUX/RUM P75 measurement.
